paragraphs: Pokémon Sleep players vote on every candy line: want, don't want or neutral. Three tabs:
New players go straight to My votes after signing in, and land on the Tier list once everything is voted.

The sign-in sheet explains what an account unlocks; public visitors can browse Everyone first. The ? in the nav opens the full help any time (Esc, ×, "Got it" or a tap outside closes it). First-time sign-ins land on Profile with the guided setup enabled, including OAuth, Google’s sign-in button and email links; returning players land on the Tier List, or their explicit shared-link destination. For new players, a shared destination (including its search) survives Profile setup and is consumed only after the saved profile is checked, or setup is explicitly skipped.
